exposure: PICC catheter placement in upper limb
PICC catheter placement in lower limb
cohort: The study participants were 389 hospitalized premature newborns in the NICU, weighing less than 1500 grams.
finding: Bacterial colonization of peripherally inserted central catheters (PICC) was significantly higher when placed in the upper limbs compared to the lower limbs of premature newborns.
